import_cutline.description: Subjects at or above Stable carry the cleared import claim; an import-layer gap on a still-stable subject holds promotion.

rules.title: Import origin must be attributed
rules.rationale: An import-layer failure on a subject still claiming a label at or above the cutline holds promotion; inherited (below-cutline or waived) narrowings are gated upstream.

records.title: Framework runtime third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored framework runtime import with attributed origin, an identified SPDX license, a pinned upstream version, an assigned update owner, and no local divergence.
records.rationale: Origin, license, and upstream pin are all recorded, the import is owned, there is no divergence, and the proof is fresh; the scan and the surface agree on a clean posture.

records.title: Framework generated schema bindings
records.subject_summary: Checked-in generated schema bindings whose generator identity and regeneration path are both recorded, with an assigned owner.
records.rationale: The generated artifact records both its generator identity and its regeneration path and is owned, so the checked-in generated code is reproducible rather than opaque.

records.title: Notebook grid-engine third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored grid-rendering import whose origin is not attributed and whose license is not yet identified, while the notebook family still claims Stable.
records.rationale: Import-layer failure: the origin is unattributed and the license is unidentified while the family still claims Stable, so the provenance gap holds promotion until both are recorded.

records.title: Framework SDK codec third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored codec import tracking a floating upstream branch instead of a pinned version; the SDK lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The upstream version is floating rather than pinned; the lane is already Beta, so this provenance narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Data-rich columnar bridge third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored columnar bridge import treated as build-time only and left without an assigned update owner, while the data-rich family still claims Stable.
records.rationale: Import-layer failure: a critical import was left ownerless because it is 'just build-time' while the family still claims Stable, so the ownership gap holds promotion until an owner is assigned.

records.title: AI-adjacent tokenizer local fork
records.subject_summary: A long-lived local fork of a tokenizer with a recorded maintain-fork decision but a divergence review that has gone stale, while the family still claims Stable.
records.rationale: Import-layer failure: a long-lived fork carries a recorded decision but its divergence review has gone stale while the family still claims Stable, so the divergence gap holds promotion until the review is refreshed.

records.title: AI-adjacent embedding-index single-source import
records.subject_summary: An effectively single-source curated embedding-index import with a current divergence review but no recorded sponsor/fork/replace decision, while the family still claims Stable.
records.rationale: Import-layer failure: a single-source import has no recorded sponsor/fork/replace decision while the family still claims Stable, so the decision gap holds promotion instead of letting the dependency drift permanently.

records.title: Review diff-engine local fork
records.subject_summary: A long-lived fork of a diff engine with a recorded replace-dependency decision but no captured divergence review; the review lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The fork has a recorded replace-dependency decision but no captured divergence review; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Companion generated client
records.subject_summary: Checked-in generated companion client code that records a regeneration path but buries the identity of the generator that produced it, while the family still claims Stable.
records.rationale: Import-layer failure: checked-in generated code records its regeneration path but not the generator identity while the family still claims Stable, so the generator gap holds promotion until the identity is recorded.

records.title: Review generated fixtures
records.subject_summary: Checked-in generated review fixtures that record their generator identity but whose regeneration path is being re-captured; the gap is time-boxed under a waiver.

waiver.reason: The generator identity is recorded; the regeneration path is being re-captured after a generator upgrade and is time-boxed under this waiver.

records.rationale: A recorded generator identity does not imply a recorded regeneration path: the path is missing, but an unexpired waiver holds the gap provisionally, so it is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Managed-depth object-store third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored object-store client import whose import-provenance proof packet has aged past its freshness SLO; the managed-depth lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The import-provenance proof packet is stale; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Companion mobile-bridge third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored mobile-bridge import whose record still lacks an owner sign-off; the companion lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The record carries no owner sign-off; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Managed-depth telemetry-shim third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored telemetry-shim import with no captured import-provenance proof packet; the managed-depth lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: No import-provenance proof packet has been captured; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Review syntax-grammar third-party import
records.subject_summary: A vendored syntax-grammar import whose relied-on provenance waiver has expired; the review lane is already Beta.

waiver.reason: A provenance re-verification was time-boxed under this waiver, which has since expired and must be renewed or cleared.

records.rationale: The relied-on waiver has expired; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream, but the expired waiver is surfaced rather than silently honored.

manifest_surface_parity.rationale: The dependency-health/import scan and the user/admin import surface agree on every subject, so a clean import card can never mask an ownerless, unattributed, or generator-free import.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking subject carries an import-layer gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.
